title: Design System: Taskscape
note: Taskscape is a native macOS app (Rust + Iced), not a web project. The live preview panel renders HTML/CSS in a browser and does not apply here, so component HTML/CSS snippets are intentionally omitted. This sidecar carries the framework-agnostic extension data (color metadata, tonal ramps, shadow vocabulary, narrative) that augments DESIGN.md. Values reflect the canonical DARK theme; light-theme counterparts are in DESIGN.md §2. Identity: 'Concrete & Bronze' — calm gray field, one warm bronze signal; frosted-glass mini HUD vs. solid main window.

display.purpose: Editable list title (Raleway Bold 32px) — the one large moment.

body.purpose: Task text, button labels, input values (Montserrat Regular 14px).

shadows.name: modal-lift
shadows.purpose: The modal card floating above its dimmed scrim.

shadows.name: sidebar-edge
shadows.purpose: Cast rightward so the sidebar reads as a raised plane.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: The one easing for hover/press/reveal (lilt EaseOutQuint).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Bronze fill, On-Accent ink, 10px radius; hover brightens + 1px lift, press settles. Built on the animated interactive widget.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Faint text-tinted fill (~5%) strengthening on hover; no border. Secondary action.

components.name: Plain Icon Button
components.description: Transparent until a faint hover tint; for actions nested in a row.

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Filled (raised), no rest border; focus brings a bronze ring; placeholder muted.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Outlined box (hairline ring) → bronze fill with a sharp check when set; hover/press animated.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Rounded-rect track (not a pill); knob left/right; bronze fill when on.

components.name: Accent Chip
components.description: Bronze fill, ink text, 8px radius, no border.

components.name: Neutral Chip
components.description: Raised fill, dim text. Attachment chips add thumbnail/icon + remove and animate on hover.

components.name: Task Row
components.description: Flat row: transparent at rest, faint fill on hover (not a stacked card).

components.name: Modal Card
components.description: One of the few real cards: surface fill, 16px radius, no border, soft shadow above the scrim.

components.name: Mini Window
components.description: Frosted-glass HUD: native NSVisualEffectView (BehindWindow) behind a transparent Iced surface; glass tint + 1px edge on top, 16px CALayer clip, no shadow.

components.name: Editable Title
components.description: 32px Raleway Bold title flipping in place between display text and a borderless field; bronze underline while editing.

narrative.overview: Taskscape is a calm gray field with a single warm bronze signal. The surface is a quiet machined neutral (graphite in dark, concrete in light) and the lone caramel-bronze accent is the action — primary button, selection, focus ring, the linked dot — its rarity the point. Two materials: the mini window is a frosted-glass HUD (Spotlight-like), the main window the solid matte workbench. The system is sharpened, not sharp: every corner rounded (8-16px), no pills, no hard edges; sharpness comes from crisp Raleway/Montserrat type, sharp-cornered icons, fill-over-outline, and restraint. Depth is the tonal ladder, not heavy shadow. It rejects the corporate SaaS dashboard, sterile gray, clutter, and gamification.
keyCharacteristics: Calm gray surfaces, one warm bronze signal used sparingly as 'the action'.
Two materials: a frosted-glass mini HUD vs. a solid matte main window.
Sharpened, soft-cornered: rounded everywhere (no sharp corners, no pills).
Fill over outline; separation by tone, not borders.
Animated micro-interactions on every control (hover/press), reduce-motion aware.

rules.name: The One Bronze Rule
rules.body: Bronze appears on a single primary affordance per view; everything else is the gray ladder + type weight.

rules.name: The Fill-Over-Outline Rule
rules.body: A component with a background gets no border; separation is the fill and its tonal step. Hairlines only where there is no fill.

rules.name: The Dual-Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Every color exists in both themes at full quality; a change to a token changes both values.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Raleway speaks for structure; Montserrat for content and controls. Never swap them.

rules.name: The Sharp-Marks Rule
rules.body: Sharpness lives in the marks (crisp type, sharp-cornered icons), not in the always-rounded surfaces.

rules.name: The Earned-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow only where a surface genuinely floats (modal, sidebar edge, glass HUD); everything else separates by tone.

dos: Do reserve bronze for one primary action per view; build the rest from the gray ladder and type weight.
Do separate filled surfaces by tone, never by a border; hairline only where there is no fill.
Do round every corner (8-16px); let sharpness come from crisp type, sharp icons, and restraint.
Do keep both themes AA-legible (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large), including bronze-on-surface and text on glass.
Do route every style through common::ui and build controls on the interactive widget (animated, reduce-motion aware).
Do keep capture frictionless: hotkey -> type -> Enter and the mini window stay ceremony-free.
donts: Don't build toward a corporate SaaS dashboard — no dense data-grid chrome, no enterprise blue.
Don't ship sterile gray — the bronze signal and crafted detail must keep the gray alive, never cold/flat.
Don't use sharp/hard corners or pills — everything is softly rounded.
Don't put a border on a filled component, or stack/nest cards (task rows are flat).
Don't gamify or clutter — no confetti/streaks/mascots, no competing controls.
Don't add a second bronze element, a decorative gradient, or a shadow 'to make it pop'.
